spec.data_source: Native IAM custom-role metadata, direct owning-scope version-3 IAM policy, and unfiltered paginated Cloud Asset IAM policy search.
spec.predicate: A successful captured scoped IAM policy contains the current role with at least one declared principal; conditional grants remain declared consumers. A current non-deleted custom role has no principal-bearing grant in the complete owning-scope version-3 IAM policy and unfiltered complete Cloud Asset IAM search.
spec.title: Custom role has a declared grant in scoped IAM inventory
spec.description: Reviews current custom-role definitions for declared consumers in the owning project or organization. The role metadata must be fully read, project-number aliases independently verified, and the exact role must have no principal-bearing grant in the complete direct root policy and unfiltered paginated Cloud Asset scoped IAM search before it can fail. Scope restrictions and Cloud Asset supported-resource coverage remain explicit. This is structural cleanup evidence, not authentication history or a safe-deletion assertion.
spec.remediation_hint: Confirm role ownership and resource-coverage gaps before removing an obsolete custom role.
